title: V4 (C1 and C2) legend hides the widest-batch marker in both cycles
evidence: Figure title cites "Widest batch: 92 parents, 53 s" (NIFTY) / "75 parents, 92 s" (SENSEX) but that batch (NIFTY D0 14:25:00-14:25:53 at y=92; SENSEX D0 10:59-11:01 at y=75) plots inside the legend box and is not visible (inspected PNG crop; legend_overlap_probe.py counts 3 artists under the legend in all four V4 figures).
repro: python3 legend_overlap_probe.py <scratch PE> ; open V4_C1_closing_batches.png D0 panel top right
impact: The most important batch of the figure (the chain the title quotes) cannot be seen; reader sees only the small batches.
proposed_fix: Place the legend outside the axes (e.g. bbox_to_anchor below the panel) or loc="lower right"; mark the widest batch with an annotation.
proposed_test: Render-time test: for every legend, assert no plotted point/segment lies inside its bbox (probe in legend_overlap_probe.py).

title: Case-study section claims the selection method was "fixed before any case was looked at" and each case says "predefined, outcome-free"; timestamped evidence does not support the first claim
evidence: git log --follow: pe/cases.py first exists in 10e33962 (2026-11-14T07:08:59Z), the same commit that first contains datasets, figures, case_studies.json and the case report; the rule text was edited again in 7117bbce (07:48:29Z, after review) although the 18 selected episodes/anchors are unchanged. The final report section H last bullet concedes history shows the rule only from the checkpoint, contradicting the heading. cycle freeze e06a711e (15:46:15Z, 2026-11-13) is solid but concerns cycles, not cases.
impact: Overstates pre-registration; reader may treat the case picks as outcome-blind and unbiased. (Selection was shown here to be price-independent and fully reproducible, so the substantive risk is wording, not results.)
proposed_fix: Rename the heading to "Selection method (structural rule; committed with the outputs; no timestamp evidence of being fixed earlier)"; drop "predefined"/"fixed before" or add a commit that precedes the outputs for future runs.
proposed_test: Doc-lint test: forbid "fixed before any case", "predefined" and "outcome-blind" in M2E_*.md unless a git commit timestamp earlier than the first output commit is referenced.

title: Every selected case sits in the first part of D-1; rule structurally favours opening-minute (seed) structures and no D0 case exists
evidence: case_selection_stats.json: all 9 NIFTY and 8 SENSEX selected episodes start on D-1; 16 of 17 start between 09:16 and 09:46 IST (exception: SENSEX CT9 at 11:15). 13 of 17 picks are the chronologically first qualifying candidate; 4 are not (NIFTY CT5 reuses the CT1 episode, NIFTY CT7 rank 2, NIFTY CT9 rank 5, SENSEX CT9 rank 6, all because the first candidate episode was already used). Qualifying candidates per type 16-179. Both NIFTY CT7 candidates (skipped rank 1, chosen rank 2) are 09:16:01 session-start bodies.
impact: Case studies are not representative of D0 (expiry day, where 69 of 85 NIFTY episodes end) or late-session behaviour; "no candidate wing" in CT7 may mainly describe session-start staging (first-minute bodies).
proposed_fix: Add a stratified rule (e.g. first qualifying per D-label and time-of-day bucket) or state the concentration prominently in the case report.
proposed_test: Test asserting each case-type pick is disclosed with its qualifying count and D-label; report generator prints the concentration.

title: Case-study PNGs are generic single-episode V2 charts with no case-specific content (no case type, quantities, anchor item, counterpart, batch or price)
evidence: Inspected NIFTY CT1,CT2,CT5,CT9 and SENSEX CT3,CT7,CT9 PNGs: title is "V2 position lifecycle timeline"; CT6/CT7/CT8/CT9 images show only the lifecycle markers of one episode, nothing about the wing/body candidates or batch that define the case; CT1 and CT5 (NIFTY) are the same episode and CT1 additionally shows the reversal successor; CT7 image (a lone short episode) invites reading "no wing existed".
impact: Case figures do not make the case; the distinguishing evidence exists only in the markdown/JSON. Risk of mis-reading CT7.
proposed_fix: Add case-type title, anchor item, quantities per event, counterpart list / batch bar; or label them "lifecycle context of the case episode".
proposed_test: Check each case PNG manifest entry carries case_type in its title and an anchor annotation.

title: V4 C1 and C2 figures (and the V6 "C1 vs C2 separate views" panel) are identical in both cycles but present as two independent views
evidence: All 304 NIFTY and 173 SENSEX batches (all thresholds), members and portions are identical between C1 and C2; V4_C1 and V4_C2 PNGs are visually the same. M2C_CLOSING_BATCH_REPORT.md:9,21,43 discloses this; the figures do not.

proposed_test: Test: if C1 and C2 batch sets are identical the figure title must say so.

title: "SENSEX has no reversal" is definition-dependent: one parent flips a short into a long within a second but is not a REVERSED event
location: reports/M2E_CYCLE_COVERAGE_REPORT.md:112; reports/M2E_POSITION_CASE_STUDIES.md:37 (tools/m2e_cases.py:61); reports/M2E_HISTORICAL_FORENSICS_REPORT.md:94; python/pe/ledger.py role rule (reversal = ONE fill crossing zero)
evidence: Raw replay: SENSEX CE77600 short episode #1 is closed by fills 12632 (60) and 12638 (100) of parent s_16053046299662 at 11:00:52 and the SAME parent opens a long episode #2 (fill 12641, 20 units) in the same second (episode #2 started_by_reversal = 0, CT5 UNAVAILABLE). NIFTY PE23850 #1->#2 shows the same pattern with different parents. Only NIFTY CE24100 (single fill 5681 crossing zero) counts as a reversal.
repro: python3 (raw_truth.py episodes on SENSEX CE|77600) ; see verify_cases.py STATS SENSEX_mixed_parent_s_16053046299662
impact: A parent-level flip (short to long, same order, same second) is presented as a plain close plus a new open and the reversal case type is reported UNAVAILABLE for SENSEX; with a parent-level definition SENSEX would have a qualifying case and the NIFTY count would change. Methodology ambiguity: both definitions defensible, only one shown.
proposed_fix: State the per-fill definition next to "no reversal" and list the parent-level same-second flips (SENSEX 1, NIFTY PE23850 cross-parent) as a measured alternative; do not pick one for the user.
proposed_test: Test counting same-second zero-crossings by fill and by parent and asserting the report text mentions both counts.
